summary: Frontend-only test of the Rank tab redesign (per-tool form colours + College Predictor cards) at 390x844 and 320x700, signed in as QA learner 7004186276. PASSED: all 5 tiles open their pane; computed colours match the spec exactly: rp-input yellow #FFD60A, pr-input teal #2DE1C2, tm-profile lime #B5F23D, rank-input/comedk-input/bitsat-input pink #FF4FAE, cmp-empty/cmp-list sky #4CC3FF. Each has a solid '<id>-head' band (tool name caps + title, dark #0B0B0F text), frame in the tool colour, main buttons (rp-show/pr-show/rank-show/comedk-show/bitsat-show/cmp-go-college) filled with the tool colour, chosen plain chips filled (rank-cat-GEN pink), text fields framed, chosen switch side tinted (rp-exam-jee yellow, rank-exam-jee pink, tm-exam-* lime). Chosen tile border = form colour. College tile metal is blood red; others maroon/indigo/teal/champagne. Collapsed summaries rp/pr/rank/comedk/bitsat show icon + text + Edit in tool colour and reopen the form. JEE 180: rank-list, rank-list-head (segments, branch, PDF), rank-tap-hint, 25 cards rank-seat-0..24 with medal, tags, branch, CLOSING/ROUND/2025 SE stats, teaser + pink 'Cutoff dekho' CTA (123x39); star (44x44) toggles WITHOUT opening sheet; card tap and CTA tap open rank-college; after closing, rank-seat-0-viewed 'Dekha · …' and hint title '1 college dekhe, shabaash!'. rank-page-2 shows rank-seat-25+, 5 rank-near cards under BAS THODA SA DOOR open the sheet. Chart mode: rank-chart-line-99.5 -> 20 rank-chart-seat cards, open sheet. COMEDK 110: 25 cards (CLOSING/2025 SE/FEE/SAAL), star ok, CTA opens comedk-college sheet, viewed + hint ok. BITSAT 280: cards CUTOFF/2025 SE/AAPKA, tap expands 5-year history 2022-2026 with CTA 'Band karo', tap collapses, viewed, bitsat-rest-show reveals bitsat-rest cards. Target: tm-college framed lime, BITSAT shows tm-campus strip with chips. Compare: cmp-empty + cmp-go-college opens College predictor; with 2 starred colleges cmp-list ticks fill sky, cmp-table renders; shortlist sheet lists 2 items. No horizontal scroll at 390 or 320; header bands and tiles not clipped. Issues are cosmetic: the glow does not show on web (and probably not on Android); the 2025 SE box gets cut off at 320px; chart cards do not get the 'Dekha' tag; small copy and data-label points.

ui_bugs.issue: The glow does not render in the web preview. Computed box-shadow on rank-tool-* (selected) and on the form Strip is 'rgb(255,79,174) 0px 0px 0px 0px' (zero blur). Cause: shadowOpacity/Radius/Offset sit in StyleSheet.create (styles.pressOn, styles.form) while shadowColor is added as a separate inline object, so RN-web 0.21 outputs a color-only shadow. The CTA pulse glow shows the reverse problem: rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 0 0 12px, a BLACK glow instead of pink. Android also ignores shadow* without elevation, so the 'glow' part of 'chamke' is probably iOS-only. Border colour works everywhere. Reference: src/rank/ToolGrid.tsx:37,60; src/rank/controls.tsx:24,121; src/rank/CollegeCard.tsx:74,136

At 320px the trend sub-line is cut off with an ellipsis on most cards: JEE '10,623 → 10,1…' (rank-seat-0..19-trend), COMEDK '2,424 → 1,5…' (19 cards). For BITSAT the main VALUE is cut ('▲ 4 tough', '▲ 11 tough': 35 boxes). 'Naya' sub '2025 mein nahi tha' is also cut even at 390px (rank-seat-17/22-trend, rank-near-0/3-trend, comedk-seat-17-trend). Fix: allow 2 lines, shorten the copy (e.g. '2025: nahi'), or use a smaller font / narrower label on small widths.

rank-chart-seat-N cards open the sheet, but they never get the 'Dekha' viewed tag, have no TapHint, and get no pulse. PercentileChart.tsx:57 renders SeatRow without viewed/pulse (does not use useCardViews). This is inconsistent with the list mode.

issues: The CLOSING stat (e.g. 13,994, CSAB 2) and the 2025 SE sub-line (10,623 → 10,108) show different 2026 numbers on the same card. y26 = JoSAA final close (backend rank_predictor.py:338 'y26': s.jclose), while CLOSING is the round where the seat closed. Compare 'FINAL CUTOFF' also shows 10,108. Students may read this as a contradiction; label the sub-line e.g. 'JoSAA final: 10,623 → 10,108'.
bitsat-tap-hint subtitle reuses the JEE copy 'Har round ka cutoff, seats aur 2025 se trend: sab andar hai.' BITSAT has no rounds/seats inside; the card actually expands to 5-year cutoffs.

The rank-chart panel is not a form panel, so its chosen category chip (rank-chart-cat-GEN) is white, not pink, while the My-marks form beside it is pink. Minor inconsistency inside the same pink tool.
CollegeCard accessibilityLabel always ends 'Cutoff dekho' even when the card is open and the CTA says 'Band karo' (expanded state is set, so this is low impact).

action_items: Make the selection glow render: put shadowColor in the same style object as shadowOpacity/Radius/Offset (or use boxShadow on web via Platform.select), and add elevation for Android (ToolGrid pressOn, Strip form, CollegeCard ctaGlow). The CTA pulse glow currently renders black on web.

Fix the 2025 SE stat box cut-off: at 320px the sub-line is cut for JEE and COMEDK, and the BITSAT value '▲ N tough' is cut. 'Naya' sub '2025 mein nahi tha' is cut at 390px too. Allow 2 lines or shorten the copy.
Optional: track viewed/pulse for the rank-chart-seat cards (PercentileChart.tsx:57). Clarify the 2025 SE sub-line as JoSAA final. Give BITSAT its own tap-hint subtitle.
critical_code_review_comments: Star is a sibling absolute-positioned Press outside the card Press, so starring never opens the sheet. Verified.
accent.tsx uses AccentContext + InForm to scope colours cleanly; Toggle only recolours plain chips (no own soft/ink), so level chips keep their own colours. Good.
useCardViews persists the 'seen' flag on the device, so the pulse only happens the first time. The viewed set is per mounted list, so it resets when the student switches exam or page remounts.
seed_data_creation: None. Starred rank-seat-0/1 (JEE) and comedk-seat-1 only in browser localStorage of throwaway contexts; all unstarred afterwards (verified aria-selected=false). No academic writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: on /entry use page.click + keyboard.type for entry-phone-input / entry-pin-input (page.fill alone left Sign in not navigating), then click text 'RANK' tab. For Compare, saved colleges are auto-picked (2/3 chune); tapping cmp-item-N toggles off. Sheets close with Escape. Chart lines: rank-chart-line-<pct> e.g. 99.5. Clip check: query '[data-testid^=prefix] [dir=auto]' with scrollWidth>clientWidth.
rca_of_issue: Glow: RN-web compiles StyleSheet shadow props into a class boxShadow and the separate inline {shadowColor} becomes its own inline boxShadow with 0 blur, which overrides it. Clipping: the stat box is flex:1 of a 3-column row, so at 320px each box is about 80px wide and numberOfLines={1} cuts off strings longer than about 10 characters.
